svg.title: Data acquisition procedure and data preprocessing steps
svg.desc: Figure inventory: Left panel contains a task/load table, a seated participant silhouette, radar emitter, thermal/RGB/NIR camera icons, labels, and radar measurement arrow leading into preprocessing. Right panel contains five preprocessing rows: raw frame thumbnails, arrows, rounded yellow processing steps, face crop thumbnails, downsampled thumbnails, and a range matrix output. Base frames f01-f03 define the table, acquisition drawing, and preprocessing flow. Symmetry/equipartition: the right flow is arranged in five horizontally aligned processing rows with common column anchors; the left table uses horizontal row partitioning and a central vertical divider. SAM mappings established after native construction: thermal above sensor draft_sensor_thermal_above to asset_sam_region_000020; RGB camera draft_sensor_rgb to asset_sam_region_000023; NIR camera draft_sensor_nir to asset_sam_region_000022; thermal below sensor draft_sensor_thermal_below to asset_sam_region_000021; radar emitter draft_radar_emitter to asset_sam_region_000024; participant/acquisition silhouette block draft_participant_group to asset_sam_region_000025. These assets are used in-place with source_crop coordinates.

g.desc: Table origin is the upper left of the tabular region. Rows are stacked downward with a central vertical divider separating task text from expected cognitive load.

Origin is the seated participant. To the left is the radar emitter; to the upper right are camera/sensor blocks. Radar measurement arrow exits from emitter across the body toward the preprocessing Raw IQ chips. Sensor lines run rightward/downward into raw frame thumbnails.
Origin is the first raw-frame column. Each row conducts rightward: raw frame, arrow, yellow operation, arrow, face crop, arrow, downsampled or range output.
